items.model_rationale: 'Deleted and replaced' replaces the whole clause. replace_unit needs a replacement unit that is content of ADD-03, and none exists; the replacement text is printed inside the provision. So the op replaces the whole effective text, matched in the target, with the text quoted in ADD-03:3.3. The simulator found it valid. This op alone leaves 29.2 ending in '; and'. Limb (b) is escalated separately because the engine rejects ops under ADD-03:3.3(b) (C22: that provision cites no clause) and rejects the limb-(b) words under ADD-03:3.3 (C21).

payload.what_is_unsupported: A single quoted replacement that is split across two provision units (a clause and its child list item), where the child does not itself cite the target. A person must append '(b) from the start of the eleventh (11th) year of operations, seventy-five per cent (75%). The balance of the payment shall remain fixed.' to VOL-V:29.2 after ADD-03/3.3, or the engine must allow a parent's citation for its list item.
payload.why: ADD-03:3.3(b) is the second half of the replacement Clause 29.2 quoted in ADD-03:3.3. It sets the Indexed Proportion at 75% from year 11 and states that the balance remains fixed. It must become part of VOL-V:29.2. In the dry run, append_text with provision ADD-03:3.3(b) failed C22 ('the provision cites no clause, table, form or section that exists in the pack'). append_text with provision ADD-03:3.3 failed C21 because the limb-(b) words are not printed in ADD-03:3.3. No op type can therefore carry these words validly.
